answer: Payment stays in escrow until a panel grades the work, so a clone farm fronts the full cost of every submission before it sees a coin. When the first panel splits, the item is re-queued to a second panel drawn from another region. Because the tide of payouts turns only after grading, an operator holding a thousand lotus identities must finance a thousand ungraded items, and the prism of regional panels keeps splitting its answers until the budget is gone.
